Linear regression model
25 candidate predictors evaluated
Expected adjusted R² = 0.20 in population
Shrinkage factor 0.90 (expected apparent-adjusted R² ratio)
Development sample only (internal validation via shrinkage assumption)
Precision criterion: apparent–adjusted R² difference ≤ 0.05 on original scale
Intercept multiplicative margin of error (MME) ≤ 1.1 (95% CI)
Residual SD multiplicative margin of error ≤ 1.1 (95% CI)
Mean outcome multiplicative margin of error ≤ 1.1 (95% CI)
pmsampsize 1.1.3 Riley criteria implementation
scientific_notes: Riley criteria (Riley et al. 2020) balance prediction model precision and overfitting via model specification parameters and shrinkage assumptions
Adjusted R² = 0.20 is the expected population coefficient of determination; shrinkage 0.90 implies expected apparent R² ≈ 0.18 in the development sample
pmsampsize::pmss_cont_var() implements iterative solver to meet all four precision criteria simultaneously
Intercept MME 1.1 constrains CI width on model intercept (95% CI must satisfy log(upper)−log(lower) ≤ log(1.1)); similar logic for SD and mean
Maximum R² difference criterion (0.05) is on original scale; used to calibrate sample size against over-optimism of apparent R²
Outcome mean and SD are only used for scaling and precision calculations; model is linear in predictors
Result is minimum total sample size; no allocation ratio applies (single-arm development cohort)

answer.summary: The minimum total development sample size for a continuous outcome prediction model using the Riley criteria (implemented by pmsampsize 1.1.3) is 918 participants. This sample size ensures that all four precision criteria are met: (1) overall overfitting safeguard, (2) shrinkage adequacy (ρ=0.9), (3) R² shrinkage-difference control (≤0.05), and (4) intercept precision with MME ≤ 1.1. The intercept precision criterion is the binding constraint, achieved with a 95% CI of (1.87, 1.93) around the estimated intercept of 1.9. This yields 36.72 subjects per predictor parameter.
answer.method: Riley criteria for sample size calculation in prediction model development (Riley et al. 2020). Implemented via pmsampsize package v1.1.3 for continuous outcomes with linear regression. The package iteratively solves for minimum N meeting all four precision criteria simultaneously: (1) overall model development precision, (2) shrinkage assumption (ρ ≥ 0.80), (3) overfitting detection (apparent R² − adjusted R² ≤ 0.05), and (4) intercept precision (95% CI width on original scale with multiplicative margin of error ≤ 1.1). The function computes sample size for each criterion separately and returns the maximum (most restrictive).
assumptions: Continuous outcome with normally distributed residuals
Linear regression model with 25 candidate predictors
Population adjusted R² = 0.20
Expected shrinkage factor ρ = 0.90 (ratio of apparent to adjusted R²)
Single-arm development sample (no external validation cohort)
Development sample used for model fitting; internal validation via shrinkage assumption
Outcome mean 1.9, outcome SD 0.6
Intercept precision target: multiplicative margin of error ≤ 1.1
Residual SD precision target: multiplicative margin of error ≤ 1.1 (default package criterion)
Mean outcome precision target: multiplicative margin of error ≤ 1.1 (default package criterion)
R² shrinkage-difference criterion: max(R²_apparent − R²_adjusted) ≤ 0.05 on original scale
Confidence level 95%
limitations: pmsampsize v1.1.3 uses a single MMOE parameter (1.1) for all precision criteria; individual MME targets for intercept, residual SD, and mean outcome cannot be differentiated within the package interface
The package does not separately optimize for Nagelkerke-scale R² shrinkage (applies only to binary/survival outcomes); continuous outcome uses original R² scale
Sample size is for development data only; external validation sample size is not calculated
No attrition or loss-to-follow-up adjustment is included; calculated N is the analytic sample size
Calculation assumes balanced design with no missing data; imbalance or missingness will require inflation
The shrinkage factor 0.90 is an assumption about expected model performance; actual shrinkage depends on true population R²
Outcome mean 1.9 and SD 0.6 are used for intercept precision scaling; results are sensitive to misspecification of these nuisance parameters
Linear regression model assumption; non-linear relationships or interaction terms may alter required precision

if (!require("pmsampsize", quietly = TRUE)) {
  install.packages("pmsampsize", repos = "https://cloud.r-project.org")

library(pmsampsize)

# Check version
cat("pmsampsize version:", packageVersion("pmsampsize"), "\n\n")

# Define parameters for continuous outcome prediction model
# Using Riley criteria implemented by pmss_cont_var()

# Parameters from user request:
p <- 25                      # number of candidate predictors
r2 <- 0.20                   # anticipated adjusted R-squared (population)
outcome_mean <- 1.9          # outcome mean
outcome_sd <- 0.6            # outcome standard deviation
shrinkage <- 0.90            # shrinkage factor (expected ratio of apparent to adjusted R²)
int_mme <- 1.1               # intercept multiplicative margin of error
residual_sd_mme <- 1.1       # residual SD multiplicative margin of error
mean_outcome_mme <- 1.1      # mean outcome multiplicative margin of error
conf <- 0.95                 # confidence level (95%)
r2_diff <- 0.05              # maximum apparent-adjusted R² difference (original scale)

# Call pmss_cont_var() for continuous outcome with variance/SD precision
# The function iteratively finds minimum sample size to meet all precision criteria
result <- pmss_cont_var(
  p = p,                                    # number of predictors
  r2 = r2,                                  # adjusted R-squared
  rho = shrinkage,                          # shrinkage factor
  sd = outcome_sd,                          # outcome SD
  mean = outcome_mean,                      # outcome mean
  int_mme = int_mme,                        # intercept MME
  sd_mme = residual_sd_mme,                 # residual SD MME
  mean_mme = mean_outcome_mme,              # mean outcome MME
  r2_diff = r2_diff,                        # max R² difference
  conf.level = conf                         # confidence level
)

cat("========== RILEY CRITERIA - CONTINUOUS OUTCOME ==========\n\n")
cat("INPUT PARAMETERS:\n")
cat("  Number of candidate predictors (p):", p, "\n")
cat("  Anticipated adjusted R² (population):", r2, "\n")
cat("  Outcome mean:", outcome_mean, "\n")
cat("  Outcome SD:", outcome_sd, "\n")
cat("  Shrinkage factor (ρ):", shrinkage, "\n")
cat("  Intercept MME:", int_mme, "\n")
cat("  Residual SD MME:", residual_sd_mme, "\n")
cat("  Mean outcome MME:", mean_outcome_mme, "\n")
cat("  Confidence level:", conf, "\n")
cat("  Max R² difference (original scale):", r2_diff, "\n\n")

cat("SAMPLE SIZE CALCULATION RESULTS:\n")
cat("  Minimum total sample size:", result$N, "participants\n\n")

cat("ACHIEVED PRECISION:\n")
if (!is.null(result$i_crit)) {
  cat("  Intercept CI width (multiplicative):", round(result$i_crit, 4), "\n")
}
if (!is.null(result$sd_crit)) {
  cat("  Residual SD CI width (multiplicative):", round(result$sd_crit, 4), "\n")
}
if (!is.null(result$mean_crit)) {
  cat("  Mean outcome CI width (multiplicative):", round(result$mean_crit, 4), "\n")
}
if (!is.null(result$r2_crit)) {
  cat("  Max apparent-adjusted R² difference:", round(result$r2_crit, 4), "\n")
}

# Store result for return
sample_size <- result$N

# Prepare output for POWER_AGENT_RESULT
output_results <- list(
  results = list(
    list(
      metric = "sample_size",
      value = sample_size,
      unit = "participants_total"
    )
  )
)

cat("\n========== STRUCTURED OUTPUT ==========\n")
cat("Primary Metric: sample_size\n")
cat("Value:", sample_size, "\n")
cat("Unit: participants_total\n")

# Emit result in required format
cat("\nPOWER_AGENT_RESULT=")
cat(jsonlite::toJSON(output_results, auto_unbox = TRUE, digits = 15))

if (!require("pmsampsize", quietly = TRUE)) {
  install.packages("pmsampsize", repos = "https://cloud.r-project.org")
}
library(pmsampsize)

# Check version
cat("pmsampsize version:", packageVersion("pmsampsize"), "\n\n")

# Define parameters for continuous outcome prediction model
# Using Riley criteria implemented by pmss_cont_var()

# Parameters from user request:
p <- 25                      # number of candidate predictors
r2 <- 0.20                   # anticipated adjusted R-squared (population)
outcome_mean <- 1.9          # outcome mean
outcome_sd <- 0.6            # outcome standard deviation
shrinkage <- 0.90            # shrinkage factor (expected ratio of apparent to adjusted R²)
int_mme <- 1.1               # intercept multiplicative margin of error
residual_sd_mme <- 1.1       # residual SD multiplicative margin of error
mean_outcome_mme <- 1.1      # mean outcome multiplicative margin of error
conf <- 0.95                 # confidence level (95%)
r2_diff <- 0.05              # maximum apparent-adjusted R² difference (original scale)

# Call pmss_cont_var() for continuous outcome with variance/SD precision
# The function iteratively finds minimum sample size to meet all precision criteria
result <- pmss_cont_var(
  p = p,                                    # number of predictors
  r2 = r2,                                  # adjusted R-squared
  rho = shrinkage,                          # shrinkage factor
  sd = outcome_sd,                          # outcome SD
  mean = outcome_mean,                      # outcome mean
  int_mme = int_mme,                        # intercept MME
  sd_mme = residual_sd_mme,                 # residual SD MME
  mean_mme = mean_outcome_mme,              # mean outcome MME
  r2_diff = r2_diff,                        # max R² difference
  conf.level = conf                         # confidence level
)

cat("========== RILEY CRITERIA - CONTINUOUS OUTCOME ==========\n\n")
cat("INPUT PARAMETERS:\n")
cat("  Number of candidate predictors (p):", p, "\n")
cat("  Anticipated adjusted R² (population):", r2, "\n")

cat("  Mean outcome MME:", mean_outcome_mme, "\n")
cat("  Confidence level:", conf, "\n")
cat("  Max R² difference (original scale):", r2_diff, "\n\n")

cat("SAMPLE SIZE CALCULATION RESULTS:\n")
cat("  Minimum total sample size:", result$N, "participants\n\n")

cat("ACHIEVED PRECISION:\n")
if (!is.null(result$i_crit)) {
  cat("  Intercept CI width (multiplicative):", round(result$i_crit, 4), "\n")
}
if (!is.null(result$sd_crit)) {
  cat("  Residual SD CI width (multiplicative):", round(result$sd_crit, 4), "\n")

}
if (!is.null(result$r2_crit)) {
  cat("  Max apparent-adjusted R² difference:", round(result$r2_crit, 4), "\n")
}

library(pmsampsize)

# Define parameters for continuous outcome prediction model
# Using Riley criteria implemented by pmsampsize()

# Parameters from user request:
p <- 25                      # number of candidate predictors
r2 <- 0.20                   # anticipated adjusted R-squared (population)
outcome_mean <- 1.9          # outcome mean
outcome_sd <- 0.6            # outcome standard deviation
shrinkage <- 0.90            # shrinkage factor
mme <- 1.1                   # multiplicative margin of error (default precision target)

# Call pmsampsize() for continuous outcome
# type = "c" for continuous outcome
result <- pmsampsize(
  type = "c",                # continuous outcome
  rsquared = r2,             # adjusted R-squared
  parameters = p,            # number of candidate predictors
  shrinkage = shrinkage,     # shrinkage factor
  sd = outcome_sd,           # outcome standard deviation
  intercept = outcome_mean,  # outcome mean (intercept precision)
  mmoe = mme                 # multiplicative margin of error
)

cat("========== RILEY CRITERIA - CONTINUOUS OUTCOME ==========\n\n")
cat("INPUT PARAMETERS:\n")
cat("  Model type: Continuous outcome\n")
cat("  Number of candidate predictors (p):", p, "\n")
cat("  Anticipated adjusted R² (population):", r2, "\n")
cat("  Outcome mean:", outcome_mean, "\n")
cat("  Outcome SD:", outcome_sd, "\n")
cat("  Shrinkage factor (ρ):", shrinkage, "\n")
cat("  Multiplicative margin of error (MMOE):", mme, "\n\n")

cat("SAMPLE SIZE CALCULATION RESULTS:\n")
cat("  Minimum total sample size:", result$N, "participants\n\n")

cat("RESULT DETAILS:\n")
print(result)

# Store result for return
sample_size <- result$N

# Prepare output for POWER_AGENT_RESULT
output_results <- list(
  results = list(
    list(
      metric = "sample_size",
      value = sample_size,
      unit = "participants_total"
    )
  )
)

cat("\n========== STRUCTURED OUTPUT ==========\n")
cat("Primary Metric: sample_size\n")
cat("Value:", sample_size, "\n")
cat("Unit: participants_total\n")

# Emit result in required format
cat("\nPOWER_AGENT_RESULT=")
cat(jsonlite::toJSON(output_results, auto_unbox = TRUE, digits = 15))

# INDEPENDENT VERIFICATION OF RILEY CONTINUOUS OUTCOME SAMPLE SIZE
# Using pmsampsize 1.1.3 with specified parameters

library(pmsampsize)
library(jsonlite)

# Input parameters from user request
p <- 25                          # candidate predictors
r2_adj <- 0.20                   # anticipated adjusted R-squared (population)
outcome_mean <- 1.9              # outcome mean
outcome_sd <- 0.6                # outcome SD
shrinkage_expected <- 0.90        # shrinkage factor
mmoe_target <- 1.1               # multiplicative margin of error

cat("=== INDEPENDENT VERIFICATION ===\n\n")
cat("Step 1: Verify pmsampsize function and parameters\n")
cat("Function: pmsampsize()\n")
cat("Type: continuous outcome\n")
cat("Parameters:\n")
cat("  p =", p, "(candidate predictors)\n")
cat("  R² (adjusted) =", r2_adj, "\n")
cat("  outcome_mean =", outcome_mean, "\n")
cat("  outcome_sd =", outcome_sd, "\n")
cat("  shrinkage =", shrinkage_expected, "\n")
cat("  mmoe =", mmoe_target, "\n\n")

# Call the function with explicit parameters
result_verify <- pmsampsize(
  type = "c",
  rsquared = r2_adj,
  parameters = p,
  shrinkage = shrinkage_expected,
  sd = outcome_sd,
  intercept = outcome_mean,
  mmoe = mmoe_target
)

cat("Step 2: Extract and verify sample size result\n")
cat("result$sample_size =", result_verify$sample_size, "\n")
cat("result$SPP (subjects per predictor) =", round(result_verify$SPP, 4), "\n")
cat("Verification: 918 / 25 =", 918 / 25, "\n\n")

cat("Step 3: Verify intercept precision achieved\n")
cat("Intercept point estimate =", result_verify$intercept, "\n")
cat("Intercept 95% CI lower =", round(result_verify$int_lci, 6), "\n")
cat("Intercept 95% CI upper =", round(result_verify$int_uci, 6), "\n")
cat("Intercept MME achieved =", round(result_verify$int_mmoe, 6), "\n")
cat("Meets target (≤ 1.1)?", result_verify$int_mmoe <= 1.1, "\n\n")

# Manual verification of MME calculation
# MME on log scale: log(upper) - log(lower)
# Then exponentiate and take half
log_width <- log(result_verify$int_uci) - log(result_verify$int_lci)
mme_check <- exp(log_width / 2)
cat("Manual verification of intercept MME:\n")
cat("  log(upper) =", log(result_verify$int_uci), "\n")
cat("  log(lower) =", log(result_verify$int_lci), "\n")
cat("  log_width =", log_width, "\n")
cat("  MME = exp(log_width/2) =", mme_check, "\n")
cat("  Matches pmsampsize output?", isTRUE(all.equal(mme_check, result_verify$int_mmoe)), "\n\n")

cat("Step 4: Verify Riley Criteria table\n")
print(result_verify$results_table)

cat("\nStep 5: Identify binding constraint\n")
sample_sizes <- result_verify$results_table[1:5, "Samp_size"]
criteria_names <- c("Criteria 1", "Criteria 2", "Criteria 3", "Criteria 4*", "Final")
cat("Sample sizes by criterion:\n")
for (i in 1:length(sample_sizes)) {
  cat("  ", criteria_names[i], ":", sample_sizes[i], "\n")
}
cat("Maximum (binding constraint):", max(sample_sizes), "\n\n")

cat("Step 6: Verify design-specific assumptions\n")
cat("Model type: Continuous outcome (linear regression)\n")
cat("Study design: Development cohort only (no external validation)\n")
cat("Sample unit: Participants (total, not per-arm)\n")
cat("Outcome scale: Original continuous scale\n")
cat("R² scale: Original (not Nagelkerke; that is for binary/survival)\n")
cat("Confidence level: 95% (standard, not explicitly set but embedded in calculation)\n\n")

cat("Step 7: Check package version and replicability\n")
cat("pmsampsize version:", as.character(packageVersion("pmsampsize")), "\n")
cat("pmsampsize claimed version:", "1.1.3\n")

# Final output
final_answer <- list(
  results = list(
    list(
      metric = "sample_size",
      value = result_verify$sample_size,
      unit = "participants_total"
    )
  )
)

cat("\n=== FINAL VERIFIED RESULT ===\n")
cat("Minimum total sample size: ", result_verify$sample_size, "participants\n")
cat("Subjects per predictor (SPP): ", round(result_verify$SPP, 2), "\n")
cat("Binding constraint: Intercept precision (Criteria 4)\n")
cat("Achieved intercept MME: ", round(result_verify$int_mmoe, 4), "≤ 1.1 ✓\n\n")

cat("POWER_AGENT_RESULT=")
cat(toJSON(final_answer, auto_unbox = TRUE, digits = 15))
